el.Piezas originales, pintadas a mano y fir: Original pieces, hand-painted and signed. Once a piece is sold, it won't be repeated, so availability may change: please confirm when you get in touch.
el.Pinto hace más de veinte años. Empecé es: I've been painting for more than twenty years. I started out studying systems engineering, but my passion was art: I took workshops with renowned artists and haven't stopped since.
el.Mi trabajo es una búsqueda constante: ex: My work is a constant search: to express my inner self through painting. Color is the voice I use to speak without words. Materials don't limit me, which is why almost all of my works are mixed media.
el.«Un volcán de formas y colores sugerente: “A volcano of evocative forms and colors gives identity to her paintings.”<small>Marino Santa María, visual artist</small>
el.Mirá las obras disponibles y escribime p: Browse the available works and write to me about the one you like. I'll send you the price and all the details.
el.Contame dónde la querés colgar y te ayud: Tell me where you'd like to hang it and I'll help you see it on your wall before you decide.
el.Si querés, vení a verla: Come and see it, if you like
el.Podés visitar mi showroom con cita previ: You can visit my showroom by appointment and see the works in person.
el.Coordinamos el envío a cualquier punto d: We'll arrange shipping anywhere in the country, and abroad too.
el.Una obra no es solo una imagen: es una p: A piece of art is not just an image: it's a presence.
el.Convivís con ella todos los días y siemp: You live with it every day and always discover something new in it. That's why I'll help you choose the size and the spot: write to me and I'll help you see it on your wall.
el.escribime y te ayudo a que la veas en tu: write to me and I'll help you see it on your wall
el.Una serie que tuvo muchísimas obras y es: A series with a great many pieces, and a central part of my journey. A few are still available: they're ideal for starting a collection, building a composition on a wall, or giving art as a gift.
el.Si buscás una medida, una paleta o un fo: If you're looking for a specific size, palette or format, I can paint a piece to order. We'll talk about what you have in mind and what the space is like, and shape the idea together. Commissions are taken in order: write to me and I'll save your place on the list.

el.Mi taller es mi mundo: el lugar donde na: My studio is my world: the place where the works are born. By appointment, you can come see them, talk about each one over a coffee, and choose without rushing.
